# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first browser puzzle called **Falling Fit Lattice**. Preserve the mechanics of a 9×9 Sudoku-style grid: generated solved board, difficulty-selected empty sockets, tap a cell to select, tap a 1–9 shard keypad to place, highlight row/column/chamber conflicts, double-tap editable cells to clear, time the solve, and complete only when every cell is filled correctly. Present the game as a portrait block-fitting experience inspired by falling-block rhythm: numbered shards lock into a luminous lattice, rows/columns/chambers are geometric fit channels, errors are misfit collisions, and completion is a perfect-stack satisfaction moment. Use a procedural neon block totem as the focal identity, a dark animated spatial grid background, bold Orbitron/Rajdhani HUD typography, compact touch-safe controls, and approved lightweight audio/GIF feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Falling Fit Lattice

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a mobile-first canvas Sudoku-style grid puzzle, not a true falling tetromino engine. Its protected mechanics are: generate a solved 9×9 board, remove a difficulty-selected number of cells, let the player tap a cell, place a number from a 1–9 keypad, reject repeated values by row/column/3×3 chamber through conflict feedback, allow double-tap erase on editable cells, track elapsed time, and finish when the board is full and correct.

## Remix target
The prompt asks for Tetris-like falling-block rhythm, portrait UI, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, and mobile controls. To preserve mechanic truth, the rebuild reinterprets Sudoku entries as numbered block shards fitting into a lattice rather than changing the rules into falling tetromino physics. The result is a portrait block-fitting puzzle with spatial optimization language, geometric rhythm, and pressure through difficulty gap count/time.

## Protected mechanics
- 9×9 grid, 3×3 chamber structure, row/column/chamber conflict semantics.
- Difficulty selection values: 20, 35, 50 removed cells.
- Tap grid cell to select, tap keypad number to place, double-tap editable cell to erase.
- Fixed givens cannot be edited.
- Timer starts on game start and pauses outside active play.
- Completion only when full and correct.

## Transformable surfaces
- Title, HUD copy, tutorial wording, button labels, modal language.
- Canvas rendering of background, board cells, values, particles, focal mascot.
- CSS layout, menu composition, palette, typography, feedback naming.
- Audio/GIF accents from approved catalogs.

identity.title: Falling Fit Lattice
identity.prompt: Tetris falling-block puzzle with elegant spatial logic, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, mobile-first portrait controls, and iconic geometric rhythm.
identity.identity: A portrait block-lattice constraint puzzle where numbered shards snap into a luminous 9x9 structure.
identity.player_role: Lattice fitter placing numbered block shards into sockets without row, column, or chamber repeats.
identity.core_loop: Select an empty socket, choose a numbered shard, read conflict feedback, clear mistakes by double-tap, and complete the full lattice as quickly as possible.
